note: Written by hand from leaks.json (python -m tools.masking_leaks --write); the page's findings table is generated from this file and checked by --check. Every mask leak is held by xfail cases of tests/unit/test_masking_leaks.py. Rates are per 1,000 planted notes and weigh every planted form the same.

findings.claim: Japanese names in the ruling's scope leak 639 per 1,000: after 氏名 katakana, hiragana and Hepburn names leak every time; with さん, 様, 殿 or 先生 a surname outside the masker's list leaks
English names in the ruling's scope leak 333 per 1,000: after Name: a LAST, First name, initials, and the surname after Dr./Mr./Ms. stay readable; in a Name table line every form leaks
Chinese names in the ruling's scope leak 188 per 1,000: Pinyin after 姓名 every time; a surname outside the masker's list (闕, 冼, 諶) after 姓名 or before 先生 or 醫師
The Japanese insurance card's 記号・番号 leaks after its label every time
An e-mail address with a full-width ＠ is never masked, in all three languages
Unlabelled full-width Taiwan and Japan mobiles (667 per 1,000 of the form) and landlines with a 3-digit area code in brackets, (037)dd-dddd, leak; well-formed 02, 04 and other landlines are masked
A value split by a hard wrap (at a separator between groups, or mid-run) leaks 806 per 1,000
A compact 7-digit ROC birth date before 出生 is never masked (after 出生日期 it is)
An unlabelled US SSN leaks (500 per 1,000 of the form; masked after a label); rare in Taiwan and Japan

The tripwire misses 75 per 1,000 in-scope planted notes. Medium by default (cloud_enabled false; no approved external endpoint). High at a site with cloud_enabled true and an external endpoint with a g5_record on a route whose external_requires flags are set
Every 8-digit clinical date is masked in chunks and trips the tripwire (site pattern ^\d{8}$); the effect on retrieval and S2b ranking is a hypothesis, no exclusion path shown
The postcode of a masked address stays readable: the 〒 code, the Taiwan 3-digit code and the US ZIP (500 to 667 per 1,000 of the full-address forms)

findings.expected: plan 8 V6 asks more than D-337 section 1
findings.claim: Free-standing names (no label, role, title or honorific) leak 821 per 1,000. Outside D-337 section 1; plan 8's V6 claim 'masking hides identifiers in notes' asks for more
